`v0.14.0` fixes the black Omarchy window on Hyprland 0.57, stops sounds freezing the VM on PCs without a working audio device, and lets the default terminal setting work.

# Features

* On Korean Windows, Omarchy offers Hangul input instead of Chewing. Existing installs get it with their next Update > Omarchy (#376)
* Settings > Apps can list file types that Omarchy may open in Windows apps. Opening them from Omarchy arrives in a later update (#381, #375)

# Fixes

* Fix notifications and other transparent layers covering the Omarchy window in black with GPU rendering on Hyprland 0.57 (#379, #358)
* A desktop that shows for a moment and then turns black now gets the prompt to switch to CPU rendering, instead of counting as a working GPU boot (#377, #358)
* Fix the VM freezing for eight seconds at a time when Windows has no working playback device and Omarchy plays a sound (#389, #384)
* Mute Hyprland 0.57's sound for every terminal bell, so missed Tab completions no longer chime. Existing installs get it with their next Update > Omarchy (#388, #384)
* Super+Return and the Omarchy menu now open the terminal chosen in Omarchy's default terminal setting instead of always opening Foot (#386, #385)
* CPU rendering always uses the bundled runtime instead of a separately installed QEMU (#380)
* Translate the blank-window prompt into Korean and the remaining Simplified Chinese messages (#372, #373)

## Dev

* Build runtime r26 with the audio endpoint checks (#389)
* Refresh the guest package lock, which brings in Hyprland 0.57.1 and kernel 7.2.14 (#376)
* Rebuild aquamarine 0.16.0 with the cursor hotspot patch for new installs, and require only Arch's release so updates on older disks go through
